grammarFocus: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of。
title: University Education and the Balance of Theory and Practical Skills
prompt: Some people argue that universities should focus primarily on academic knowledge and theoretical understanding, while others believe that higher education should place greater emphasis on practical skills and preparation for the workplace. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, explain which position you find more convincing and why, supporting your argument with relevant examples from education or employment. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请先分别说明两种观点（重理论 vs. 重实践）的合理依据，再明确给出你自己的立场，并用教育或就业领域的具体例子加以论证。注意段落之间的逻辑衔接：每个主体段应有清晰的主题句、展开论证和例证，避免只罗列观点。建议用约40分钟完成，写完后检查是否回应了题目要求的全部内容（双方观点、个人立场、理由与例子），并核对字数是否达到250词。
